The '''''Seeker''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]]. At some point, the pair flew the ship from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]] to a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where they planned to salvage a derelict ship. However, the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Reegas Vance]] also planned to salvage the derelict and to prevent Faal and Idi-Shael from interfering with his plans, he fired upon the ''Seeker'' with his [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Blackstar'']], disabling the ''Seeker''. Faal and Idi-Shael then donned [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]] and abandoned the ''Seeker'', while Vance led a boarding party over to the stricken vessel. Faal and Idi-Shael subsequently stole the ''Blackstar'' and departed the system, leaving Vance stranded aboard the ''Seeker''.
